ask: Is it fine to ask the server again, a few times, when loading the review steps fails?
problem: In the nightly test run, adding a language got stuck on the review step. It said there were no ways to check, and Continue could not be tapped.
found: The app asked the server for the review steps only once. That night the busy server failed that one request, and the app never asked again. I made it fail on purpose and got the same stuck screen.
changed: If the request fails, the app now asks again up to five times. While it waits, the screen says Loading. With one failed request, the review steps now show and Continue works.
why: One failed request should not leave a person stuck, and asking again is the usual fix. The cause was in the app, so I did not set the test aside. A new test makes the first request fail, so this stays fixed.
touches: Every screen that shows library material now asks again after a failed request. Offline, people still see the 'not connected' note at once.

pictures.label: Before: one failed request leaves the review step empty
After: the same failed request, and the review steps show

linear.comment: Found the cause: New language's review step reads the review flows' documents from the server once. Under nightly load that one read failed, it was never retried, and the screen said "No ways to check to choose from yet." with Continue off. Same kind of race as LAN-252. Reproduced by failing that read once (new test SETUP-080): same stuck screen. Fix: the library reads ask again up to five times, and the step says Loading while waiting. PR: https://github.com/genesis-ai-dev/langquest-next/pull/418
